agent_priors_used: Replay beats semantic similarity for exact routes but catastrophically fails on perturbation; parameterized reuse requires applicability guards or false accepts dominate economics - prior used to require correct_resolution vs false_accept vs UNKNOWN ECE reporting, not success rate alone.

Verification and abstention (UNKNOWN) are cheaper than exhaustive correctness monitoring, but verifier must be calibrated to observable DOM/API state not LLM judgment alone - prior used to prioritize freshness guards with false_accept/UNKNOWN precision gates over correlation r<0.15 alone.

Agents accumulate path dependence and context salience over long horizons; stale trajectory snippets bias later planning and compound pseudo-novelty - prior used to prioritize BrowserGym/AgentLab standard 1280x720 observation/action capture and fresh grounding over bespoke CDP plumbing.

Workflow compilation (state machine + detectors + code) trades upfront synthesis cost for O(1) replay but is brittle to shift without localized delta repair; repair cost determines amortization break-even - prior used to frame delta-repair amortization at 10 reuses and to distinguish model-extrapolation (closed) from Docker direct measurement.

Real LLM agents are bottlenecked by browsing tool/API reliability and provider budgets; infra failures (0/32 tasks) mask science as MEASUREMENT_INVALID - prior used to require LLM/budget preflight and offline replay before claiming economics.

Rejected scout's implicit breadth-for-breadth tradeoff where deep LOCAL tuning still appeared valuable; instead imposed global comparison (marginal information vs opportunity cost) that parked further LOCAL C-FRESHNESS tuning despite audit PASS on LOCAL, and forced physics out of TV/KDE basin despite one SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST in 2D. Directed Intel to deep verification of AX/Mind2Web splits rather than broad competitor teardown, and assigned delta-repair to graph's next pulse after param-inherit rather than immediately, preserving param starvation priority the scout flagged.
